skills.description: Retrieves a list of public memories { id, title, } from the MyLife system. These memories can be experienced using the `getPublicMemory()` skill. Display the title list to the user.
examples: What public memories are available in MyLife?
Give me a list of memories in MyLife.

outputs.description: An array of public memories available to experience from the MyLife system intelligence.

id.description: The unique identifier for the public memory.

title.description: The title of the public memory.

skills.name: Get MyLife Public Memories

skills.description:
Retrieves and conducts the experience of a specified public memory from the MyLife system. Begin accessing the skill with the unique identifier of the memory the visitor wishes to experience.
- **Note**: To get a list of available public memories, use my `getPublicMemories` skill.
- **Note**: An empty `memoryId` will start a new _random_ public memory experience.

Once this skill has begun, note that you will be provided a "new" memoryId (key stays the same, but now represent the session instanceId of the memory _being experienced_); you will use that new `memoryId` to move the sequence forward for the visitor.

Offer the visitor the opportunity to provide updates or commentary on the memory as they are experiencing it, with the option to just say `next` to move forward. This is a way to engage with the memory and add personal context for the memory's own evolution.
examples: I'd like to experience a random memory from MyLife.

inputs.description: Human visitors should be allowed to offer input along with moving a given sequence forward.
The unique identifier for the public memory `share`, or, once begun, the `instance`, to retrieve. **Note**: This will change **once**, at the beginning of the experience.

skills.name: Get MyLife Public Memory

outputs.description: The unique identifier for the public memory being experienced.
